what: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames
title: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames
text: Parse classify scientific plant names taxonomic components: genus, specific epithet, infraspecific rank, infraspecific epithet, author. Output aligned backbone convention: Orig.Genus Title Case (first letter uppercase, rest lowercase). Orig.Species Orig.Infraspecies epithets lowercase. Infra.Rank lowercase (subsp., var., subvar., f., subf.). Author recovered input preserved original casing/punctuation (forced uppercasing). Orig.Name reconstructed : genus + species + (rank + infra) + author. Robustness rules: cf. / aff. removed parsing preserved flags (has_cf, has_aff). Hybrid markers (x/\u00D7) standalone tokens removed had_hybrid = TRUE. sp. / spp. triggers genus-classification (Rank = 1, Orig.Species = NA) sets is_sp/is_spp. infraspecific rank present infraspecific epithet missing, sets rank_missing_infra = TRUE keeps Infra.Rank Orig.Infraspecies = NA. rank appears "late" (author-like tokens), parsing best-effort rank_late = TRUE. explicit rank third token exists, function can infer unranked infraspecific epithet third token looks epithet-like (lowercase), look like start author. case implied_infra = TRUE, Orig.Infraspecies filled, Infra.Rank = NA, Rank = 3.

title: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames

title: Classify Scientific Plant Names into Taxonomic Components — classify_spnames
text: tibble one row per input name standardized columns/flags: sorter Numeric index original order. Input.Name Original input string provided user. Orig.Name Reconstructed standardized name aligned backbone + original-cased author. Orig.Genus Genus Title Case. Orig.Species Specific epithet lowercase, NA genus-(sp./spp.). Author Recovered author string (original casing/punctuation) "". Orig.Infraspecies Infraspecific epithet lowercase (ranked implied), NA. Infra.Rank Infraspecific rank lowercase (subsp., var., subvar., f., subf.), NA. Rank Numeric level: 1 genus-, 2 genus+species, 3 includes infraspecific epithet. has_cf,has_aff,is_sp,is_spp,had_hybrid,rank_late,rank_missing_infra,had_na_author,implied_infra Logical flags.

what: wcvpmatch: Taxonomic Name Reconciliation Against the 'WCVP' Backbone — wcvpmatch-package
title: wcvpmatch: Taxonomic Name Reconciliation Against the 'WCVP' Backbone — wcvpmatch-package
text: Standardizes reconciles scientific plant names World Checklist Vascular Plants ('WCVP')-style taxonomic backbone. package parses names taxonomic components applies staged exact fuzzy matching binomial trinomial inputs, including infraspecific rank-aware checks. also returns accepted-name context row-level matching flags support reproducible, auditable preprocessing downstream biodiversity, spatial, trait analyses. user-supplied backbone can passed 'target_df'; optional companion package 'wcvpdata' installed, default checklist can also used.

what: Match Scientific Names Against WCVP — wcvp_matching
title: Match Scientific Names Against WCVP — wcvp_matching
text: Runs matching pipeline exact partial matching binomial trinomial names, including infraspecific rank validation.

title: Match Scientific Names Against WCVP — wcvp_matching
code: wcvp_matching(   df,   target_df = NULL,   prefilter_genus = TRUE,   allow_duplicates = FALSE,   max_dist = 1,   method = "osa",   add_name_distance = FALSE,   name_distance_method = "osa",   profile = FALSE,   output_name_style = c("snake_case", "legacy") )

title: Match Scientific Names Against WCVP — wcvp_matching
text: df Input tibble/data.frame either Genus/Species Orig.Genus/Orig.Species. trinomials, include Infra.Rank Infraspecies (Orig.Infra.Rank/Orig.Infraspecies). target_df Optional custom target table. NULL, data read optional wcvpdata checklist available; otherwise pass target_df explicitly. prefilter_genus Logical. TRUE, prefilter target_df candidate genera (exact + fuzzy) running matching pipeline. allow_duplicates Logical. TRUE, duplicated taxon keys deduplicated internally matching expanded back original rows. Output includes input_index traceability original input. max_dist Maximum distance used fuzzy matching stages (genus, species, infraspecies). method string indicating fuzzy matching method (passed fozziejoin). Supported methods: "levenshtein": Levenshtein edit distance (default). "osa": Optimal string alignment. "damerau_levensthein" "dl": Damerau-Levenshtein distance. "hamming": Hamming distance (equal-length strings ). "lcs": Longest common subsequence. "qgram": Q-gram similarity (requires q). "cosine": Cosine similarity (requires q). "jaccard": Jaccard similarity (requires q). "jaro": Jaro similarity. "jaro_winkler" "jw": Jaro-Winkler similarity. "soundex": Soundex codes based National Archives standard. add_name_distance Logical. TRUE, add matched_dist pairwise distance input name (Input.Name fallback Orig.Name) matched_taxon_name. name_distance_method Method passed stringdist::stringdist add_name_distance = TRUE (example "osa"). profile Logical. TRUE, attach timing table "timings" attribute returned tibble, elapsed seconds per pipeline stage. output_name_style Naming style output columns: "snake_case" returns standardized lower snake_case names. "legacy" keeps historical mixed naming convention.

title: Match Scientific Names Against WCVP — wcvp_matching
